services.name: Actor_RepublishInteractionValueOnCull
behavior: Tests actor flag bit 0x20 at offset 0x06.
Returns when actor selector byte at offset 0x34 is zero.
Writes actor offset 0x34 to INTERACTION_TABLE_RUNTIME at 0x00FFAE87 plus the actor word at offset 0x32.

services.name: ActorType1E_PrepareRecoveryPlane
behavior: The caller then waits for VBlank, reloads palette bands, and continues Type-0x1E collision recovery.
